# Sprayway Retail

> > Sprayway is a trusted manufacturer of cleaning products since 1947, offering glass cleaners, furniture polish, oven cleaners, and multi-surface solutions for home and commercial use.

Sprayway Cleaners provides a comprehensive range of cleaning products with a focus on ammonia-free formulations and environmental sustainability. The company operates through PLZ Corp's retail division with distribution across the United States and serves both consumers and retailers.
